i.norm: Verifies that {@link ByteUtils#fromLittleEndian(ByteUtils.ByteSupplier, int)} reads four bytes from a {@link ByteSupplier} and decodes them as a little-endian, unsigned 32-bit value.
Four little-endian bytes: least-significant byte first. The most-significant byte is 128, so the result exceeds Integer.MAX_VALUE and must be treated as an unsigned 32-bit value held in a long.
Reconstruct the expected value from each byte and its little-endian place value.
